versions.subject: Add file_event_win_werfault_dll_hijacking
versions.detection:
selection:
  TargetFilename|endswith:
    - '\WerFault.exe'
    - '\wer.dll'
filter_whitelist:
  TargetFilename|startswith:
    - 'C:\Windows\System32\'
    - 'C:\Windows\SysWOW64\'
    - 'C:\Windows\WinSxS\'
condition: selection and not filter_whitelist
